title: Trove location fix
description: One line of location/<source>/YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl: a single GPS fix. A track/batch/segment is the set of fixes sharing one trail id, not a points array. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time of the fix

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

heading.description: course over ground, in degrees (0–360, clockwise from north)

trail.description: stable id grouping the fixes of one track/batch/segment/trip; the read-time grouping key

trail_name.description: display name for the trail (GPX track name, segment label)

mode.description: movement mode where the source classifies it (verbatim: walking, cycling, driving, transit, …)

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key (a fix id, a trip-id+seq, or a (ts,lat,lon) hash where the source gives no id)

extra.description: everything source-specific (odometer, charge, battery, motion type, wifi SSID, place confidence, …)
